More and more Americans are watching live sports. In fact, live sports dominated American screens in 2023, accounting for 96 of the top 100 most-watched TV broadcasts in the US. With an industry-leading channel lineup, advanced features like Sports Central and unmatched access to regional sports networks, DIRECTV delivers what any sports fan needs. CHOICE Want to keep a balance between price and performance? CHOICE offers a mix of national and local sports content. At $84.99 a month, the CHOICE package, in addition to everything in the ENTERTAINMENT lineup, includes college conference networks like the Big Ten Network, SEC Network and ACC Network. Additionally, CHOICE offers some regional sports networks, depending on your location. CHOICE Price includes a $10/month discount for Astound Internet customers. ENTERTAINMENT If you’re only an occasional viewer, ENTERTAINMENT covers the basics. Priced at $89.99 a month, it includes essential sports channels like ESPN, ESPN2, FS1, TBS and TNT, giving casual fans access to many major games, primetime matchups and national events. However, this package does not include any regional sports networks, which means fans may miss out on hometown team coverage for MLB, NBA and NHL. ULTIMATE For fans who follow everything from NFL to NHL, but don’t need premium movie channels, check out DIRECTV ULTIMATE. At $114.99 a month, it includes everything from CHOICE and adds specialty sports channels like MLB Network, NBA TV, NHL Network, Golf Channel and more. Following multiple sports throughout the year? ULTIMATE includes offseason coverage and niche sports, as well as regional sports networks year-round. ULTIMATE Price includes a $10/month discount for Astound Internet customers. PREMIER If you want the broadest coverage, PREMIER is the best choice. Priced at $159.99 a month, it includes every channel found in ULTIMATE, plus NFL Network, NFL RedZone, Tennis Channel and premium entertainment networks like Cinemax, Paramount+ with SHOWTIME and more. For fans who want everything, from local baseball to niche tournaments and national league coverage, PREMIER ensures you won’t miss a single moment. Whichever you choose, you can enhance your experience by bundling TV and internet with Astound’s high speed internet, ideal for streaming sports in HD or 4K. Why DIRECTV stands out as a leader in live sports DIRECTV offers access to both national and regional games. From premium league coverage to hometown team matchups, DIRECTV is the platform built for fans who want it all. Here’s how: 1. DIRECTV partners with 30+ regional sports networks DIRECTV provides access to over 30 regional sports networks, including Bally Sports, NBC Sports and others, ensuring fans can catch their local MLB, NBA and NHL teams live. These regional sports networks are included in most DIRECTV packages, giving you in-market coverage that streaming-only services can’t match. 2. Sports Central makes finding your games easy DIRECTV Sports Central is a comprehensive hub designed to enhance the viewing experience for sports enthusiasts. This feature consolidates live and upcoming games, schedules and personalized content, making it easier for fans to stay connected with their favorite teams and leagues. In Sports Central, you’ll be able to: View live and upcoming games across various sports, including football, basketball, baseball and hockey. You can also set and follow favorite teams. Record games for later viewing and set recordings for specific teams or matchups, as well as receive notifications about upcoming games. Access comprehensive schedules, so you can plan watching or recording in advance. For DIRECTV customers using Gemini devices, Sports Central offers the added benefit of integrating streaming platforms like YouTube, Prime Video, ESPN+ and Peacock. Subscribers of these platforms can access games directly through Sports Central, meaning no more switching between different apps or platforms. 3. Includes a TV guide that’s actually useful DIRECTV’s TV guide goes beyond the basics. It’s built with sports fans in mind. With a modern, intuitive layout, the guide allows you to easily find upcoming games, navigate between different sports categories and zero in on the action. It’s a huge upgrade over outdated grid systems. You can quickly record games, replay key moments or jump right back in with just a few clicks. Favorite your most-watched sports channels and create household profiles, so every viewer can have a tailored experience. 4. One integrated experience for live TV and streaming apps DIRECTV offers a better entertainment experience by combining live TV and your favorite streaming apps in a single interface. With the Gemini device, you don’t have to juggle remotes or constantly switch inputs, everything is accessible from one home screen. Add top sports streaming services like ESPN+, NBA TV, NFL Network and others into your main viewing experience. Jump from watching a live NFL game on TV, to streaming exclusive content on ESPN+ without leaving the DIRECTV platform. Maximize time spent watching, not searching. Whether you’re tuning in for live games, highlights or replays, DIRECTV makes sure it’s all in one place. 5. Find your game with voice search With DIRECTV’s built-in voice search, powered by Google Assistant, finding your favorite sports games has never been easier. Using natural language commands like “Find the Lakers game” or “Show me Yankees games this weekend,” you can instantly search across live broadcasts, on demand content and even pay-per-view events. You’ll get results like air times, channel numbers and match details. You can use this feature on the DIRECTV app on iOS and Android devices or via the Gemini voice remote, whether you’re watching on your TV or on the go. You’ll need an internet-connected device such as the DIRECTV Gemini or a smartphone, along with a Google login. Some advanced features, like filtering for only “free” content or accessing results from third-party apps like Netflix, may have limited availability. 6. Watch every game on the go with the DIRECTV app The DIRECTV app, available on both iOS and Android, puts the full power of your sports subscription in your pocket. Whether you’re traveling, at work or simply away from your main screen, the app lets you stream live sports, watch on demand content and even access your DVR recordings—all from anywhere with a stable internet connection. For sports fans, the app is packed with features that enhance mobile viewing. You can add your favorite teams from leagues like the NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL and college sports. You won’t miss a moment with real-time notifications for upcoming games, live scores and final results. Advanced functionality like split-screen viewing lets you follow multiple games at once. To use the app, you’ll need an active DIRECTV subscription and a reliable WiFi or mobile data connection. While the app supports most of DIRECTV’s core features, some content, like 4K streaming or select premium channels, may not be available on all devices or plans.
